_note: The three islands the party sailed to, west of Sellador, from the nautical campaign: Prios, then Thanatos, then Agrea. Coastlines were traced by eye from the author's three map images (original_data/maps/prios.jpg, thanatos.jpg, agrea.jpg; image pixel coordinates). Agrea's map showed only part of the island (x 0-684, y 0-425) with Mount Akamu in its top-left; the author says Akamu is a massive volcano at the CENTRE of a tropical, volcanic island like Hawaii, so the unseen west and north are INVENTED around it. Prios and Thanatos are about the same size; Agrea is the largest. Each island sits further south than the last as you sail west. Names are only those written on the author's maps; ships (The Falling Star, The Inferno, The Steady Hand) are left off.
_spacing: Distances are placeholders until the map is calibrated: the author gave sailing times (about 10.5 days from Sellador to Prios, 7 days to Thanatos, 7 days to Agrea), which are turned into map distance with pxPerDay (world pixels sailed per day; 1024 px = 20 degrees). Each island is placed coast-to-coast that many days further west of the one before it.

islands.title: Peregrine's Table

places.name: The Table
places.note: A flat rock set atop two others, like a table: a Sahuagin altar to Shokath, the shark god. It stands on the western hill, 'the flat place' where, the sea-birds say, others bring their prey.

places.name: Boar Cave
places.note: On the eastern hill, toward the rising sun: the lair of two giant dire boars, the 'king and queen' of the sea-birds' tale. A small hidden chamber holds clay jars of old coin (Selladorian, elven, dwarven and Atman) and a worn painting of islands, one above the rest hurling lightning.

islands._note: Redrawn from the author's hex-tile map original_data/maps/peregrine_hex.webp (tools/peregrine_trace.mjs): the coast, the jungle, scrub, highland, dunes and marsh hexes, the four mountain glyphs, the rivers (the blue lines on the hex borders) and the two sand islets to the north-east. sizeRatio keeps the island the width the old invented outline had, so the western island chain stays where it was.

islands.title: Agrea
islands._note: Traced from the author's full map of Agrea, original_data/maps/agrea_full.png (665x620), by tools/agrea_trace.mjs: the coast, the islets east and south, and the two named places (Caer Khimer, Sunken Caves). The terrain areas (Mount Akamu, the ridges, the rainforests) were outlined by eye over that picture. Names are only those written on the author's map; the ships (The Inferno, The Steady Hand) are left off. The island's size comes from the author's 'about 4 days to sail all the way round' (circumnavigateDays).

islands.title: Baratoria

places.name: The Wailing Rock
places.note: A lone rock standing out of open water east of Grand Isle, about 20 feet across. The pencil map marks it with a small ringed symbol.

islands._note: Traced from the author's pencil drawing original_data/maps/baratoria.png (tools/baratoria_trace.mjs): Grand Isle (the large crescent), Walkers Cay (north-east), South Cay (south-east), and The Wailing Rock (a marker only: at about 20 feet across it is far too small to draw). Image pixel coordinates; scale set so Grand Isle is 5 miles long north to south (author), which makes Walkers Cay about 2.7 miles across and South Cay about 1.9. Centred on world (205, 244); bandScale thins the shallows round the islands to match. The faint pencil scribbles between the islands (shoals or ripples) are not drawn.

islands.title: The Umbral Isle
islands._note: Traced from the author's illustrated map original_data/maps/umbral.png (tools/umbral_trace.mjs): the island, the north-western tip, and the little isle to the east. Where clouds hide the coast it is drawn halfway across them. Terrain areas are outlined by eye. No size was given, so the island is drawn about 18 miles across (SCALE in the tracer); centred three days' sailing north-west of Agrea.

_latitude: Latitude model (2026-10-29, Mercator reading, see tools/climate.mjs): Sellador is centred on y~262 = 49 N and the equator is at y~567. Author (2026-10-29): Agrea is the most tropical (yCenter 465 = ~18 N), Thanatos is chilly at times (a magical cold of undeath; yCenter 345 = ~37 N), and Prios is the most temperate and the most northerly of the three (yCenter 302 = ~45 N).
_refScale: World px per image px of the island the other islands' sizes are measured from (Agrea's scale before its full map was drawn). Agrea's own scale now comes from its coast length (circumnavigateDays), so redrawing Agrea does not resize Prios, Thanatos or the unnamed isle.
